description: Calculate statutory or commercial (B2B) late-payment interest, broken down by NBP reference-rate periods.

typ.description: kc = statutory late-payment interest (Civil Code art. 481, NBP reference rate + 5.5 pp); h10 = commercial B2B transactions, non-public debtor (NBP reference rate on 1 Jan / 1 Jul + 10 pp); h8 = commercial transactions, public healthcare debtor (NBP reference rate on 1 Jan / 1 Jul + 8 pp).
